q: I like music ___ I can dance to.
explain: 先行词 music 是物，关系词在从句中作 dance to 的宾语，用 that（也可用 which）。who 指人，whose 表所属，where 表地点。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：The man which is talking to Mary is our headmaster.
explain: 错误。先行词 the man 指人，关系代词在从句中作主语应用 who 或 that，which 只能指物。

q: I still remember the day ___ I first came to this school.
explain: 从句不缺主语和宾语，缺时间状语，用关系副词 when，相当于 on which。

q: Paper ___ from wood.
explain: be made from 表示由……制成（看不出原材料），纸是被制成的，用一般现在时的被动语态 is made。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：The letter was written by my father yesterday.
explain: 正确。一般过去时的被动语态 was written 结构正确，by 引出动作的执行者。

q: It was ___ an interesting story ___ we all laughed.
explain: 中心词是名词 story，用 such a/an+形容词+名词+that 结构；若用 so 应是 so interesting a story。

q: The book ___ be Lucy's. Her name is on the cover.
explain: 由名字在封面上作有把握的肯定推测，用 must be，意为一定是。can't 表否定推测，与句意相反。

q: My grandma stays at home to ___ my little sister.
explain: look after 表示照顾、照料；look for 寻找，look up 查阅，look like 看起来像。

q: 翻译判断：「这是一本值得读的书。」译为 This is a book which is worth reading.
explain: 正确。be worth doing 用主动形式表被动含义，which 引导定语从句修饰 book，译法恰当。

q: What ___ you ___ at eight last night?
explain: at eight last night 指过去某一时刻，强调那时正在进行，用过去进行时 were doing。

q: He has worked in this factory ___ ten years.
explain: for+时间段与现在完成时连用；since 后接时间点，ten years 是时间段，故选 for。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：He has joined the army for three years.
explain: 错误。join 是瞬间动词，不能与 for three years 连用，应改为 has been in the army for three years 或 joined the army three years ago。

q: They ___ the national flag every Monday morning.
explain: 升国旗是人为把旗举起，用及物动词 raise；rise 是不及物动词，不能接宾语。

q: —What about going to the park this weekend? —___
explain: What about...? 是提建议，赞同时用 Good idea 回应；Never mind 用于安慰，You're welcome 回应道谢。

q: These photos ___ on the Great Wall last year.
explain: photos 与 take 是被动关系，last year 表过去，用一般过去时的被动语态 were taken。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：You can look up the new words in your dictionary.
explain: 正确。look up 表示查阅，接名词作宾语时名词可放中间也可放后面；若宾语是代词则必须放中间。

q: Do you know the man ___ saved the boy in the river?
explain: 先行词 the man 指人，关系词在从句中作主语，用 who（或 that）；whom 只能作宾语，此处不能作 saved 的主语。

q: Do you know the reason ___ he was late this morning?
explain: the reason why... 是固定搭配，why 引导定语从句表原因，相当于 for which。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：While I was doing my homework, my father was read a newspaper.
explain: 错误。过去进行时的结构是 was/were+doing，应把 was read 改为 was reading。

q: She ___ you as soon as she gets home.
explain: as soon as 引导的从句用一般现在时 gets，主句要用一般将来时，即主将从现。

q: Teenagers should ___ to take care of themselves.
explain: 青少年是被教育的对象，含情态动词的被动语态结构为 should be+过去分词，即 should be taught。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：The reason why he was late was because he missed the bus.
explain: 错误。the reason why...is that... 是固定句型，表语从句用 that 引导，不能再用 because，否则语义重复。

q: He has ___ playing basketball as a hobby.
explain: take up doing 表示开始从事某种爱好或活动；take off 起飞、脱下，与句意不符。

q: 即使下大雨，我也要去帮他。I'll go to help him ___ it rains heavily.
explain: even if 表示即使，引导让步状语从句；if 是条件，意为如果，与句意不符。

q: I ___ I could fly like a bird.
explain: 对难以实现的愿望用 wish，从句用虚拟语气 could；hope 指有可能实现的愿望，且不接虚拟语气的从句。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：You must be tired after the long walk.
explain: 正确。must be 表示对现在情况有把握的推测，意为一定，符合语境。

q: —Have you ___ been to the Great Wall? —No, never.
explain: ever 意为曾经，常用于疑问句和否定句；already、just 多用于肯定句，yet 多用于句末。

q: The firefighters are trying to ___ the fire.
explain: put out 表示扑灭（火）；put on 穿上，put up 张贴，put off 推迟。

q: More roads ___ in our city in five years.
explain: in five years 表将来，roads 与 build 是被动关系，用一般将来时的被动语态 will be built。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：The window was broke by the naughty boy.
explain: 错误。被动语态要用过去分词，break 的过去分词是 broken，应为 was broken。

q: Our team ___ the first prize in the singing competition.
explain: 赢得奖项用 win，win the first prize 即获一等奖；beat 的宾语是对手而不是奖项。

q: Is there anything ___ I can do for you?
explain: 先行词是不定代词 anything 时关系代词只用 that；that 在从句中作 do 的宾语，也可省略。

q: 交际判断：—Would you mind closing the door? —Of course not. 此对话是否得体。
explain: 正确。Of course not 表示当然不介意，应答礼貌得体。

q: Please ___ me carefully, or you may ___ nothing.
explain: listen 是不及物动词，接宾语要加 to；hear 表结果听见。第一空是听的动作，用 listen to；第二空是听的结果，用 hear。

q: She always ___ her daughter before breakfast.
explain: dress 的宾语是人，dress sb 表示给某人穿衣；wear、put on 的宾语是衣物，不能接 her daughter。

q: By the time we got to the cinema, the film ___ for ten minutes.
explain: by the time+过去时从句，主句用过去完成时；且 for ten minutes 要求延续性动词，begin 是瞬间动词，须换成 be on，故为 had been on。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：What he said are true.
explain: 错误。what 引导的主语从句作主语时通常视为单数，谓语应为 is，即 What he said is true.

q: The woman to ___ you spoke just now is our new manager.
explain: 介词 to 后指人只用 whom，即介词+whom 结构；介词之后不能用 who。

q: —Hello, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr Smith. —___
explain: 预约场景中接线方会商定具体时间，确认明天下午三点是否方便最得体；其余选项不礼貌或不合语境。

q: 判断句子语法是否正确：Everything that he said seemed reasonable.
explain: 正确。先行词是不定代词 everything，关系代词只能用 that，句子结构无误。

q: Let's take a taxi ___ we can get there on time.
explain: 打车是为了准时到达，so that 引导目的状语从句，意为以便；because 表原因，though 表让步，逻辑不符。

q: How do you ___ your classmates?
explain: get along with sb 表示与某人相处；get up 起床，get off 下车，get on 上车。

q: The teacher ___ the exam papers in class yesterday.
explain: give out 表示分发；give up 放弃，give in 屈服，give away 赠送、泄露。

q: The problem is ___ we can get enough money.
explain: 表语从句表是否用 whether，不能用 if（if 不引导表语从句）；that 无词义，不合句意。

q: We have known each other ___ we were children.
explain: since+过去时从句与现在完成时连用，表示自从……以来；when、until、before 不能与现在完成时这样搭配。

q: Please ___ the lights when you leave the room.
explain: 离开房间应关灯，turn off 表示关闭电器；turn on 打开，turn up 调大，turn down 调小。

q: —Where is Jack? —I'm not sure. He ___ to the library.
explain: 不确定的推测可能去了，对过去情况作推测用 may have done；must go 是对现在的推测，should have gone 表示该去而没去，含责备意味。

q: The house ___ windows face south belongs to my uncle.
explain: 空格后有名词 windows，表房子的窗户，用 whose 引导定语从句；whose 既可指人也可指物。

q: More than 200 people ___ the meeting yesterday.
explain: 出席会议用 attend the meeting；join 指加入组织成为一员，take part 须加 in 才能接宾语，join in 多接活动。

q: He ___ the wallet himself; he was not even in the office that day.
explain: 由那天他不在办公室对过去作否定推测，用 can't have done，意为不可能做过；mustn't 表禁止，不能用来表推测。
